text: Svyazinvestneftekhim's own website states that the Republic of Tatarstan is its sole shareholder, acting through the republic's Ministry of Land and Property Relations; the company's site describes it as the vehicle created to manage the republic's state-owned stakes in its largest enterprises.
short: Svyazinvestneftekhim is wholly owned by the Republic of Tatarstan.

source.name: АО «Связьинвестнефтехим» — Информация об акционере (company's own shareholder-information page)
source.quote: Единственным акционером АО «Связьинвестнефтехим» является Республика Татарстан, права и обязанности акционера от имени которой осуществляет Министерство земельных и имущественных отношений Республики Татарстан.
source.note: Translation: 'The sole shareholder of AO Svyazinvestneftekhim is the Republic of Tatarstan, whose shareholder rights and obligations are exercised by the Ministry of Land and Property Relations of the Republic of Tatarstan.'

additionalSources.name: Kommersant-Kazan: «Связьинвестнефтехим» станет крупнейшим акционером банка «Ак барс»
additionalSources.note: Translation: '100% of SINKh [Svyazinvestneftekhim] shares are owned by the government of Tatarstan.' Same article, quoting the bank's press office in 2009: 'the government of Tatarstan, through ministries, state organizations and related companies, controls 96% of the bank's charter capital'.
